checks.output:
Usage: bash scripts/install_controller.sh
Requires restored .envs/controller-base; clones fixed SDK into sdk and installs editables only into .venv-controller.

usage: browsecomp_collection.py [-h]
                                {prepare,create-config,collect,export} ...

Frozen-corpus BrowseComp research collection, independent of the LCB
collector. Gold answers and document texts stay in private preparation
artifacts. Research splits are group-disjoint subdivisions of the upstream
test set, not leaderboard splits. Collection never invokes a judge or treats
an answer as benchmark success.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,create-config,collect,export}
    prepare             Freeze public questions, grouped splits and full
                        corpus index
    create-config       Create the fixed 4090 research profile
    collect             Collect immutable first infrastructure-valid attempts
    export              Materialize v2 data from audited accepted primary
                        attempts

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: browsecomp_collection.py prepare [-h] --questions QUESTIONS --corpus
                                        CORPUS --output OUTPUT --revision
                                        REVISION --history-ids HISTORY_IDS

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --questions QUESTIONS
  --corpus CORPUS
  --output OUTPUT
  --revision REVISION
  --history-ids HISTORY_IDS

usage: browsecomp_collection.py create-config [-h] --prepared-data
                                              PREPARED_DATA --sdk-path
                                              SDK_PATH --run-root RUN_ROOT
                                              --output OUTPUT --base-url
                                              BASE_URL
                                              [--service-manifest SERVICE_MANIFEST]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prepared-data PREPARED_DATA
  --sdk-path SDK_PATH
  --run-root RUN_ROOT
  --output OUTPUT
  --base-url BASE_URL
  --service-manifest SERVICE_MANIFEST

usage: browsecomp_collection.py collect [-h] --config CONFIG --split
                                        {historical_dev,dev,fit,tune,calibration,test}
                                        [--resume] [--retry-infrastructure]
                                        [--limit LIMIT] [--release-test]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --split {historical_dev,dev,fit,tune,calibration,test}
  --resume
  --retry-infrastructure
  --limit LIMIT
  --release-test

usage: browsecomp_collection.py export [-h] --run-root RUN_ROOT --output
                                       OUTPUT

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --run-root RUN_ROOT
  --output OUTPUT
